Abdallah Al-Fakhori.note: Al-Fakhouri stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Another aspect is how Al-Fakhouri sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Abdallah Al-Fakhori.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友构成Abdallah Al-Fakhouri踢法的核心。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Abdallah Nasib.note: What separates Nasib is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Nasib waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate detail appears when he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Abdallah Nasib.noteZh: Abdallah Nasib最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Mohammad Abu Alnadi.summary: Mohammad Abu Alnadi is a Jordanian centre-back for Selangor and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.note: For Alnadi, the foundation is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Look first at how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. Beyond that, watch how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.noteZh: Mohammad Abu Alnadi的优势在于对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。最直接的表现是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Husam Abu Dahab.note: Dahab's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. At another point in the move, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Husam Abu Dahab.noteZh: 最能体现Husam Abu Dahab特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Mohammad Abu Ghoush.note: Taha stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a separate phase, Taha gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.noteZh: 最能体现Mohammad Taha特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.note: What separates Hashish is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Hashish gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. Away from that action, he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者构成Mohammad Abu Hashish踢法的核心。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。除此之外，值得留意他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohannad Abu Taha.note: The key to Taha is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate part of his game is how Taha turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Mohannad Abu Taha.noteZh: 理解Mohannad Abu Taha，要先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Mohammad Abu Zraiq.note: Zraiq's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Away from that moment, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Mohammad Abu Zraiq踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Yazan Al-Arab.note: For Al-Arab, the foundation is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Look first at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Yazan Al-Arab.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Yazan Al-Arab踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mohammad Al-Daoud.note: Watch Al-Daoud for reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. The clearest example is how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. A separate clue is how Al-Daoud uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.noteZh: Mohammad Al-Daoud的比赛建立在对抗后球权松动时的第一反应之上。首先看他如何在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。另一个方面是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ali Azaizeh.note: Watch Azaizeh for making purposeful movement away from the ball. The clearest example is how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. Elsewhere, Azaizeh looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ali Azaizeh.noteZh: 最能体现Ali Azaizeh特点的是有目的地进行无球移动。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。除此之外，他也会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Ali Olwan.note: The key to Olwan is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. There is another side to his game: he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ali Olwan.noteZh: Ali Olwan最鲜明的特点是防线重组前制造干净射门。一个直接线索是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。另一个独立细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Mahmoud Al-Mardi.note: The key to Mardi is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. In another phase, Mardi moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.noteZh: 理解Mahmoud Mardi，要先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Noor Al-Rawabdeh.note: Al-Rawabdeh's signature is organizing the nearby unit before the next phase begins. Watch how he uses short cues to keep nearby passing and pressing options connected. Separately, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.noteZh: Noor Al-Rawabdeh的优势在于下一阶段开始前组织身边队友。最直接的表现是他会用简短提醒让附近的传球与逼抢选择保持连接。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mousa Al-Taamari.note: For Al-Taamari, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. A separate point is how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Mousa Al-Taamari.noteZh: 观察Mousa Al-Taamari时，可以先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Amer Jamous.note: Watch Jamous for making purposeful movement away from the ball. The clearest example is how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. Elsewhere, Jamous turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Amer Jamous.noteZh: 最能体现Amer Jamous特点的是有目的地进行无球移动。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。除此之外，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Anas Badawi.note: Badawi stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a separate phase, Badawi gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Anas Badawi.noteZh: 看Anas Badawi的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Nour Bani Attiah.note: The key to Attiah is command of the crowded space around goal. He attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. One more thing to notice is how Attiah keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Nour Bani Attiah.noteZh: 观察Nour Bani Attiah时，可以先看掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。另一个比赛细节是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Ehsan Haddad.note: What separates Haddad is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Haddad gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. In another phase of play, he slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Ehsan Haddad.noteZh: 看Ehsan Haddad的作用，关键是封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Ibrahim Sadeh.note: For Sadeh, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Beyond that, watch how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Ibrahim Sadeh.noteZh: 看Ibrahim Sadeh的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Nizar Al-Rashdan.note: What separates Al-Rashdan is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Al-Rashdan waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate detail appears when he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.noteZh: Nizar Al-Rashdan最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Odeh Fakhoury.note: Al-Fakhouri's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. Watch how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. At another point in the move, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Odeh Fakhoury.noteZh: 理解Odeh Al-Fakhouri，要先看有目的地进行无球移动。他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Rajaei Ayed.note: For Ayed, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Rajaei Ayed.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定构成Raja'ei Ayed踢法的核心。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Saed Al-Rosan.note: Watch Al-Rosan for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate clue is how Al-Rosan meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Saed Al-Rosan.noteZh: 看Saed Al-Rosan的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Saleem Obaid.note: Obaid stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. In a separate phase, Obaid uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Saleem Obaid.noteZh: 看Saleem Obaid的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yazeed Abulaila.note: Laila stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. In a separate phase, Laila leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Yazeed Abulaila.noteZh: 长时间无事可做后依然保持专注是理解Yazeed Abu Laila踢法的关键。先看他如何在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。到了另一个比赛环节，他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。
